id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

startTime.description: The beginning of the time interval for which usage information is collected

endTime.description: The end of the time interval for which usage information is collected

sessionItems.description:
The list of session usage items generated for this report
These store session metadata, such as vCpuHours and total session duration. Used to calculate usage fee.

memberItems.description: The list of member usage items generated for this report

sessionVCpuHours.description: The sum of {@link ExMachinaUsageReportItem.Session#vCpuHours} across all {@link sessionItems}

sessionDurationSeconds.description: The sum of {@link ExMachinaUsageReportItem.Session#sessionDurationSeconds} across all {@link sessionItems}

endTimeInclusive.description:
The {@link endTime} is exclusive, i.e. we generate all usage until (but not including) this time.
Typically the endTime is the first day of the following month, so when displaying the time range to the user, we
print "1/1/2020 - 1/31/2020" instead of "1/1/2020 - 2/1/2020" by subtracting a millisecond.

timeRange.description: The readable time range computed using {@link startTime} and {@link endTime}, e.g. 1/1/2023 - 1/31/2023

title: A report that summarizes ExMachina usage over a given time interval. Used to drive billing.
name: ExMachinaUsageReport
